title: Vertical editor walkthrough: pick, swap, tilt, retype
summary: A vertical product tour of a motion editor: a template is picked from a gallery, its phone screen is swapped, tilted and recoloured, a headline is retyped, then URL and mark close. Each step is one visible edit, paced to the VO.
use_when: Showing a creative or design tool end to end in one vertical clip
A template or remix product where the edit itself is the payoff
VO-led tutorials where every sentence maps to one UI action
Reels or shorts that need a product demo under 50 s

look.type_style: UI sans at app scale (labels 1-2 % H); display grotesk for the edited words, bold, tight, white-to-grey vertical gradient, about 45 % of artboard width; URL in medium sans, 4 % W

sfx.event: phone lands in the laptop canvas, mark at the end
soft slide or zoom transitions between UI views
cursor clicks on buttons, menus and the colour picker
letters typed into the text layer
light sweep across the wordmark and the URL

params.brand: brand.json: bg gradient top colour (blue in the reference), panel dark, accent, display font
params.content.templates: 6-8 gallery tile images or titles; one is the phone template that gets picked
params.content.phoneScreens: 2 phone screen images: the template default and the swapped-in screen
params.content.headline: the big word on the text artboard and the 1 word it is retyped to (<= 6 letters each)
params.content.wordmark: product name that gets the light sweep, and the 2-word placeholder it is retyped to
params.vo: VO lines with times; each row starts on the sentence that names its action

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (+-0.25 s): rows are the reference times; camera numbers partly from motion.json estimates. Two hard cuts (2.97, 9.97); five soft transitions from cuts.json (3.77, 12.27, 14.00, 15.77, 22.73), ids chosen from the sheet look (zoom blur, slide), not measured exactly. Springs and staggers are suggested defaults, overshoot not measurable. Music and VO only: every sfx is planned by the glue rule, not observed. Near-black stretch 39.77-45.44 is a separate end card with no editor chrome. The phone in rows 1, 5, 11 is a real 3D device turning, hence device-3d and heavy render. cut_on_beat 2/7. Proposed terms (not used as ids): template-pick, layer-swap. Theme dark by majority, the blue gradient backdrop sits above L 0.2 but below 0.6.
